knowledge.name: Synthetic March 2026 time ledger
knowledge.detail: Twelve fixed entries capture consultants, projects, dates, hours, rates, narratives, billability, and approval state.

knowledge.name: Billing rules and dispute controls
knowledge.detail: Packaged rules define narrative, daily-hours, rate, approval, budget, invoice eligibility, and dispute evidence checks.

knowledge.name: Project budget and contract evidence
knowledge.detail: Five fictional projects provide clients, T&M or fixed-fee terms, budgets, billed-to-date values, and remaining amounts.

knowledge.name: Invoice and authorization evidence
knowledge.detail: Fixed invoice history, approval gaps, milestone requirements, and two disputes ground month-end finance review.

intelligence_processing.name: Unbilled work triage
intelligence_processing.detail: Identifies unapproved billable entries, computes blocked value, and presents outstanding invoices without changing status.

intelligence_processing.name: Project and consultant rollups
intelligence_processing.detail: Aggregates billable hours and values by project and consultant while keeping amounts separate from posted revenue.

intelligence_processing.name: Time-entry and budget audit
intelligence_processing.detail: Applies deterministic narrative, hours, rate, approval, and budget thresholds while leaving every source entry unchanged.

intelligence_processing.name: Approval-gated invoice support
intelligence_processing.detail: Groups only approved billable T&M evidence and holds fixed-fee work until contractual milestone evidence is reviewed.

intelligence_processing.name: Disputed-hours evidence analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Separates evidence present from missing support and recommends authorized internal review paths for each dispute.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio draft conversation
clients_user_interface.detail: Billing and finance personas invoke five grounded behaviors through an unpublished conversational agent experience.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat and API
clients_user_interface.detail: The BasicAgent-compatible Python tool runs locally through Brainstem chat, streaming, UI, and health endpoints.

clients_user_interface.name: Evidence-first review responses
clients_user_interface.detail: Outputs lead with ready, blocked, flagged, held, or disputed work and state the next authorized reviewer action.

management_reporting.name: Month-end billing blockers
management_reporting.detail: Reports blocked entries, missing evidence, approval needs, unbilled value, and outstanding invoice history.

management_reporting.name: Project and consultant close summary
management_reporting.detail: Shows hours, billable values, average rates, contract types, budget use, and remaining project amounts.

management_reporting.name: Audit and budget control report
management_reporting.detail: Lists narrative and hours exceptions plus project budget warnings for project-manager and finance review.

management_reporting.name: Invoice and dispute review package
management_reporting.detail: Presents eligible T&M support, fixed-fee holds, evidence gaps, and internal resolution paths without posting invoices.

tools.name: Portable TimeEntryBillingAgent
tools.detail: A single BasicAgent-compatible Python file exposes five read-only operations over bundled synthetic records.

tools.name: Deterministic billing functions
tools.detail: Python calculations derive hours, values, audit flags, budget status, invoice eligibility, and collection metrics.

tools.name: Synthetic knowledge package
tools.detail: Two uploaded files provide the complete fictional ledger, billing rules, invoice history, and dispute evidence.

tools.name: Brainstem RAPP runtime
tools.detail: The local-first server discovers the portable agent and serves grounded chat without customer credentials.

tools.name: Deployment-selected foundation model
tools.detail: The environment-selected model routes natural-language requests and composes responses from bounded evidence.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the draft conversational agent, two knowledge files, and five skills; publication remains separate.

tools.name: Dynamics 365
tools.detail: An approved production seam for finance and project records; no live connection or write is enabled in the evidence.

tools.name: SharePoint and Microsoft Teams
tools.detail: Approved seams for governed evidence and human review; the current package performs no upload, message, or approval action.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only grounding
supporting_features.detail: The agent uses the frozen March 2026 snapshot and does not browse, query finance systems, or invent missing evidence.

supporting_features.name: Five bounded operations
supporting_features.detail: Routing is limited to unbilled reports, billing summaries, time-entry audits, invoice support, and disputes.

supporting_features.name: Deterministic control calculations
supporting_features.detail: Fixed formulas govern billable totals, unbilled value, rate checks, daily-hours limits, budgets, and collections.

supporting_features.name: Finance and project review gates
supporting_features.detail: Consultant, project-manager, billing-manager, milestone, and authorized finance approvals remain human decisions.

supporting_features.name: Fixed-fee milestone boundary
supporting_features.detail: Fixed-fee time remains delivery evidence and cannot determine invoice value without contractual milestone support.

supporting_features.name: No-write billing boundary
supporting_features.detail: The agent never mutates time entries, grants approval, recognizes revenue, posts accounting entries, or generates invoices.

supporting_features.name: Validated draft lifecycle
supporting_features.detail: All five locked cases passed manual and Copilot Studio preview evidence while the solution remained unpublished.
